Free aim practice for shooters and MOBAs

Aim Room is a free browser aim trainer for quick target acquisition, moving targets and precise cursor control. Start with Shooter or MOBA, challenge Survival, or save a custom drill.

Aim practice FAQ

Is Aim Room a free online aim trainer?

Yes. Aim Room runs in a modern browser with no installation and stores your practice history locally on this device.

What does aim practice train?

It isolates target acquisition, flicking, micro-adjustments and cursor control. Aim Room measures hits per second, accuracy and your best streak so you can compare equivalent sessions.

Is Aim Room for shooters or MOBAs?

Both. Shooter emphasizes random appearances, side entries and targets near the cursor. MOBA emphasizes moving lines, rebounds and nearby targets that resemble cursor placement for skillshots.

Which aim practice profile should I choose?

Choose Shooter for fast flicks and micro-adjustments, MOBA for moving trajectories, or Custom to save your preferred duration, target size, patterns and pace.

How does Survival mode work?

You begin with three lives. A missed click or expired target removes one life, and the base interval becomes 100 milliseconds faster every ten hits until it reaches 300 milliseconds.

What does Progressive mode do?

Progressive mode reduces the base spawn interval by 50 milliseconds every ten hits until 200 milliseconds. The lower bar counts each cycle and signals every real speed increase.

How long should I practice aim?

Start with a short session you can repeat consistently. Compare attempts with the same duration and configuration, and stop when fatigue begins to reduce your control.

Does browser aim practice match a game exactly?

No browser can reproduce every game's raw input, field of view or target physics. Use Aim Room to practice consistent cursor control and compare results within the same setup.
